revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Surveillance Van Budget
revealWordProblem.text: Detective Reyes can spend at most $85 on gas for her surveillance van this week. She has already spent $52. Write an inequality for the additional amount g she can still spend, solve it, and describe how you would graph the solution set on a number line.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Write 52 + g ≤ 85. Subtracting 52 gives g ≤ 33. Additional spending cannot be negative, so the contextual solution is 0 ≤ g ≤ 33: Reyes can spend from $0 through $33 more. To graph the inequality alone, use a closed circle at 33 and shade left. For the spending situation, keep only the segment from 0 to 33, including both endpoints; monetary amounts are measured to the nearest cent.

questions.explanation: Subtract 6 from both sides: x > 14 − 6 = 8. Graph: open circle at 8, shade right.
choiceFeedback: The boundary number is right, but the inequality symbol flipped. Adding or subtracting on both sides never changes the direction of the symbol.
An inequality has many solutions, not just one. Look at what the > symbol allows on either side of the boundary.
Not quite. Subtract 6 from both sides: x > 14 − 6 = ___.
hints: Solve it like an equation: x has 6 added to it. The > symbol just rides along.
Subtract 6 from both sides — the inequality symbol keeps pointing the same way when you subtract.
Compute 14 − 6 and keep the >. Then test: pick a number bigger than your result and check it makes x + 6 > 14 true.
questions.explanationEs: Resta 6 en ambos lados: x > 14 − 6 = 8. Gráfica: círculo abierto en 8, sombrea hacia la derecha.
hintsEs: Resuélvelo como una ecuación: a x se le suman 6. El símbolo > solo va de acompañante.
Resta 6 de ambos lados: el símbolo de desigualdad sigue apuntando igual cuando restas.
Calcula 14 − 6 y conserva el >. Luego prueba: escoge un número mayor que tu resultado y revisa que haga verdadera x + 6 > 14.

questions.explanation: Add 9 to both sides: x ≤ 3 + 9 = 12. Graph: closed circle at 12, shade left.
choiceFeedback: Not quite. Add 9 to both sides: x ≤ 3 + 9 = ___.
You found the right boundary, but the symbol turned around. Adding the same number to both sides keeps the original direction.
This names only the boundary value. The ≤ symbol includes that value and a whole range on one side of it.
hints: x has 9 subtracted from it. Undo that first; the ≤ symbol keeps its direction.
Add 9 to both sides. Adding the same number to both sides never flips the symbol.
Compute 3 + 9 and keep the ≤. Check by testing a value at or below your boundary in the original inequality.
questions.explanationEs: Suma 9 en ambos lados: x ≤ 3 + 9 = 12. Gráfica: círculo cerrado en 12, sombrea hacia la izquierda.
hintsEs: A x se le restan 9. Deshaz eso primero; el símbolo ≤ conserva su dirección.
Suma 9 a ambos lados. Sumar el mismo número a ambos lados nunca voltea el símbolo.
Calcula 3 + 9 y conserva el ≤. Comprueba probando un valor igual o menor que tu límite en la desigualdad original.

questions.explanation: Subtract 10 from both sides: x ≥ 25 − 10 = 15. Graph: closed circle at 15, shade right.
choiceFeedback: The boundary is correct, but the symbol was reversed. Subtracting the same amount from both sides leaves the direction alone.
An inequality describes a whole set of values, not a single one. Check what the ≥ symbol includes.
Not quite. Subtract 10 from both sides: x ≥ 25 − 10 = ___.
hints: What's being done to x? 10 is added. Plan the inverse operation before you look at the choices.
Subtract 10 from both sides; the ≥ stays exactly as it is.
Compute 25 − 10 and keep the ≥. Test your boundary value — it should make both sides of the original exactly equal.
questions.explanationEs: Resta 10 en ambos lados: x ≥ 25 − 10 = 15. Gráfica: círculo cerrado en 15, sombrea hacia la derecha.
hintsEs: ¿Qué se le hace a x? Se le suman 10. Planea la operación inversa antes de mirar las opciones.
Resta 10 de ambos lados; el ≥ se queda exactamente igual.

steps: 1. Isolate the variable using inverse operations on both sides (same as equations)
2. Write the simplified inequality with the variable on the left (e.g. x > 5)
3. Graph the solution set on a number line with open/closed circle and arrow shading
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Solve and Graph Inequalities is shading the number line in the wrong direction after solving. For example, a student solves x + 4 > 10 correctly to get x > 6, but then shades LEFT toward smaller numbers instead of RIGHT toward greater numbers. The shading direction always matches the solved symbol, not the original problem: '>' and '≥' shade right (greater numbers), '<' and '≤' shade left (smaller numbers) — check this AFTER you solve, not before. To catch this mistake, substitute one shaded value and one unshaded value back into the original inequality: the shaded value should make it true, and the unshaded value should make it false.

level1.stem: Solve x + 4 > 11. What is the boundary number?
level1.stemEs: Resuelve x + 4 > 11. ¿Cuál es el número límite?
hints: 4 is added to x. Subtract 4 from both sides.
hintsEs: A x se le suma 4. Resta 4 en los dos lados.
level1.explanation: Subtract 4 from both sides: 11 − 4 = 7 → x > 7 Graph it: open circle at 7 → shade right
level1.explanationEs: Resta 4 en los dos lados: 11 − 4 = 7 → x > 7 Grafícala: círculo abierto en 7 → sombrear a la derecha

level1.stem: Solve x − 3 ≤ 9. What is the boundary number?
level1.stemEs: Resuelve x − 3 ≤ 9. ¿Cuál es el número límite?
hints: 3 is subtracted from x. Add 3 to both sides.
hintsEs: A x se le resta 3. Suma 3 en los dos lados.
level1.explanation: Add 3 to both sides: 9 + 3 = 12 → x ≤ 12 Graph it: closed circle at 12 → shade left
level1.explanationEs: Suma 3 en los dos lados: 9 + 3 = 12 → x ≤ 12 Grafícala: círculo cerrado en 12 → sombrear a la izquierda

level1.stem: Solve x + 8 ≥ 20. What is the smallest value of x that makes it true?
level1.stemEs: Resuelve x + 8 ≥ 20. ¿Cuál es el valor más pequeño de x que la hace verdadera?
hints: Subtract 8 from both sides. The symbol ≥ includes the boundary number.
hintsEs: Resta 8 en los dos lados. El símbolo ≥ incluye el número límite.
level1.explanation: Subtract 8 from both sides: 20 − 8 = 12 → x ≥ 12 Check the boundary: 12 + 8 = 20 → 20 ≥ 20 ✓
level1.explanationEs: Resta 8 en los dos lados: 20 − 8 = 12 → x ≥ 12 Comprueba el límite: 12 + 8 = 20 → 20 ≥ 20 ✓

level1.stem: Solve x + 5 > 12. What is the boundary number?
level1.stemEs: Resuelve x + 5 > 12. ¿Cuál es el número límite?
hints: 5 is added to x. Subtract 5 from both sides.
hintsEs: A x se le suma 5. Resta 5 en los dos lados.
level1.explanation: Subtract 5 from both sides: 12 − 5 = 7 → x > 7 Graph it: open circle at 7 → shade right
level1.explanationEs: Resta 5 en los dos lados: 12 − 5 = 7 → x > 7 Grafícala: círculo abierto en 7 → sombrear a la derecha

level1.stem: Solve x − 18 ≥ 25. What is the smallest value of x that makes it true?
level1.stemEs: Resuelve x − 18 ≥ 25. ¿Cuál es el valor más pequeño de x que la hace verdadera?
hints: 18 is subtracted from x. Add 18 to both sides. Does ≥ include the boundary?
hintsEs: A x se le resta 18. Suma 18 en los dos lados. ¿El símbolo ≥ incluye el límite?
level1.explanation: Add 18 to both sides: 25 + 18 = 43 → x ≥ 43 Check the boundary: 43 − 18 = 25 → 25 ≥ 25 ✓
level1.explanationEs: Suma 18 en los dos lados: 25 + 18 = 43 → x ≥ 43 Comprueba el límite: 43 − 18 = 25 → 25 ≥ 25 ✓

level2.stem: Eli solves x + 9 < 15 and gets x < 24. Is he right? What is the boundary number?
level2.stemEs: Eli resuelve x + 9 < 15 y obtiene x < 24. ¿Tiene razón? ¿Cuál es el número límite?
hints: Test Eli's answer with x = 20. Is 20 + 9 < 15? Then undo the + 9.
hintsEs: Prueba la respuesta de Eli con x = 20. ¿Es 20 + 9 < 15? Luego deshaz el + 9.
level2.explanation: Test a value from Eli's answer: 20 + 9 = 29 → 29 < 15 ✗ Subtract 9 from both sides: 15 − 9 = 6 → x < 6
level2.explanationEs: Prueba un valor de la respuesta de Eli: 20 + 9 = 29 → 29 < 15 ✗ Resta 9 en los dos lados: 15 − 9 = 6 → x < 6

level2.stem: Solve 6x ≥ 45. What is the boundary number?
hints: 6x means 6 times x. Divide both sides by 6. The boundary can be a decimal.
hintsEs: 6x significa 6 por x. Divide los dos lados entre 6. El límite puede ser un decimal.
level2.explanation: Divide both sides by 6: 45 ÷ 6 = 7.5 → x ≥ 7.5 Graph it: closed circle at 7.5 → shade right
level2.explanationEs: Divide los dos lados entre 6: 45 ÷ 6 = 7.5 → x ≥ 7.5 Grafícala: círculo cerrado en 7.5 → sombrear a la derecha

level2.stem: Solve x − 6 < 9. What is the boundary number?
level2.stemEs: Resuelve x − 6 < 9. ¿Cuál es el número límite?
hints: 6 is subtracted from x. Add 6 to both sides.
hintsEs: A x se le resta 6. Suma 6 en los dos lados.
level2.explanation: Add 6 to both sides: 9 + 6 = 15 → x < 15 Graph it: open circle at 15 → shade left
level2.explanationEs: Suma 6 en los dos lados: 9 + 6 = 15 → x < 15 Grafícala: círculo abierto en 15 → sombrear a la izquierda

level2.stem: Solve x ÷ 2.5 < 4. What is the boundary number?
level2.stemEs: Resuelve x ÷ 2.5 < 4. ¿Cuál es el número límite?
hints: x is divided by 2.5. Multiply both sides by 2.5.
hintsEs: x se divide entre 2.5. Multiplica los dos lados por 2.5.
level2.explanation: Multiply both sides by 2.5: 4 × 2.5 = 10 → x < 10 Test the boundary: 10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 → 4 < 4 ✗
level2.explanationEs: Multiplica los dos lados por 2.5: 4 × 2.5 = 10 → x < 10 Prueba el límite: 10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 → 4 < 4 ✗

level2.stem: A bus can carry at most 40 people. 23 people are already on it. Write and solve an inequality for the number of people p who can still get on. What is the greatest number?
level2.stemEs: Un autobús puede llevar como máximo 40 personas. Ya hay 23 personas arriba. Escribe y resuelve una desigualdad para el número de personas p que todavía pueden subir. ¿Cuál es el mayor número?
hints: The people on the bus plus the new people is at most 40. Write 23 + p ≤ 40.
hintsEs: Las personas en el autobús más las nuevas es como máximo 40. Escribe 23 + p ≤ 40.
level2.explanation: Write the inequality: 23 + p ≤ 40 Subtract 23 from both sides: 40 − 23 = 17 → p ≤ 17
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la desigualdad: 23 + p ≤ 40 Resta 23 en los dos lados: 40 − 23 = 17 → p ≤ 17

level3.stem: Solve n − 6 > 9. Which number line shows the solution set?
choices: An open circle at 3 with shading to the right
An open circle at 15 with shading to the right
A closed circle at 15 with shading to the right
An open circle at 15 with shading to the left
choiceFeedback: That subtracts 6 from 9. To undo a subtraction of 6, add it: 9 plus 6.
The symbol is greater than, not greater than or equal to, so 15 itself is not a solution.
The boundary is right but the direction is not. Values above 15 make the statement true.
level3.explanation: Add 6 to both sides to isolate the variable: n > 9 + 6, so n > 15. The symbol > uses an open circle at 15, and the solutions are the numbers greater than 15, so the shading goes to the right.

level3.stem: Kim and Lou solve 5x > 30. Kim gets x > 6. Lou gets x > 150. What is the boundary number?
level3.stemEs: Kim y Lou resuelven 5x > 30. Kim obtiene x > 6. Lou obtiene x > 150. ¿Cuál es el número límite?
hints: What undoes multiplying by 5? Test a value from each answer.
hintsEs: ¿Qué deshace multiplicar por 5? Prueba un valor de cada respuesta.
level3.explanation: Divide both sides by 5: 30 ÷ 5 = 6 → x > 6 Test a value Lou leaves out: 5 × 7 = 35 → 35 > 30 ✓
level3.explanationEs: Divide los dos lados entre 5: 30 ÷ 5 = 6 → x > 6 Prueba un valor que Lou deja fuera: 5 × 7 = 35 → 35 > 30 ✓

level3.stem: Solve 8x ≤ 52. What is the boundary number?
hints: Divide both sides by 8. The boundary can be a decimal.
hintsEs: Divide los dos lados entre 8. El límite puede ser un decimal.
level3.explanation: Divide both sides by 8: 52 ÷ 8 = 6.5 → x ≤ 6.5 Graph it: closed circle at 6.5 → shade left
level3.explanationEs: Divide los dos lados entre 8: 52 ÷ 8 = 6.5 → x ≤ 6.5 Grafícala: círculo cerrado en 6.5 → sombrear a la izquierda

level3.stem: An elevator can carry at most 1,200 pounds. Each box weighs 75 pounds. Write and solve an inequality for the number of boxes b. What is the greatest number of boxes?
level3.stemEs: Un elevador puede llevar como máximo 1,200 libras. Cada caja pesa 75 libras. Escribe y resuelve una desigualdad para el número de cajas b. ¿Cuál es el mayor número de cajas?
hints: 75 pounds times b boxes is at most 1,200. Write 75b ≤ 1,200.
hintsEs: 75 libras por b cajas es como máximo 1,200. Escribe 75b ≤ 1,200.
level3.explanation: Write the inequality: 75b ≤ 1,200 Divide both sides by 75: 1,200 ÷ 75 = 16 → b ≤ 16 Check the boundary: 75 × 16 = 1,200 ✓
level3.explanationEs: Escribe la desigualdad: 75b ≤ 1,200 Divide los dos lados entre 75: 1,200 ÷ 75 = 16 → b ≤ 16 Comprueba el límite: 75 × 16 = 1,200 ✓

level3.stem: Solve x + 4.5 ≤ 3 × 4. What is the boundary number?
level3.stemEs: Resuelve x + 4.5 ≤ 3 × 4. ¿Cuál es el número límite?
hints: Find the value of 3 × 4 first. Then undo the + 4.5.
hintsEs: Primero halla el valor de 3 × 4. Luego deshaz el + 4.5.
level3.explanation: Simplify the right side: 3 × 4 = 12 → x + 4.5 ≤ 12 Subtract 4.5 from both sides: 12 − 4.5 = 7.5 → x ≤ 7.5 Graph it: closed circle at 7.5 → shade left
level3.explanationEs: Simplifica el lado derecho: 3 × 4 = 12 → x + 4.5 ≤ 12 Resta 4.5 en los dos lados: 12 − 4.5 = 7.5 → x ≤ 7.5 Grafícala: círculo cerrado en 7.5 → sombrear a la izquierda
